QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] Stubborn Weather
QuestInfo.0: Now that the children have stopped crying you might be able to talk with them.
QuestInfo.1: You started playing dolls with the kids to keep them from crying, and then SNAP! You accidentally broke their toy. Lightning flashed across the sky as their anger rose. You'd better find a new toy for them to play with.
QuestInfo.2: The lightning stopped when you brought the children a new toy. Could #ethe weather really be affected by their moods?#n

1.msg: (#bBring the kids 10 toys to cheer them back up.)
